content: 第十四关（前）

speaker: Ch'en
content: Come in.

speaker: Amiya
content: ...Dr. Kal'tsit!

speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Amiya...

speaker: Kal'tsit
content: ...{@nickname}.

speaker: Kal'tsit
content: So you've come.

speaker: Ch'en
content: Ahem.

raw: [name="Ch'en"]   Chief Wei, the other two representatives of Rhodes Island have also arrived.
speaker: Ch'en
content: Chief Wei, the other two representatives of Rhodes Island have also arrived.

speaker: Wei Yenwu
content: Ah, excellent.

raw: [name="Wei Yenwu"]   Please take a seat. Miss Kal'tsit is currently explaining the situation to me.
speaker: Wei Yenwu
content: Please take a seat. Miss Kal'tsit is currently explaining the situation to me.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]   Allow me to continue then. Mister Wei, I trust that you have a good grasp of the situation already.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Allow me to continue then. Mister Wei, I trust that you have a good grasp of the situation already.

raw: [ImageTween(xFrom=0, yFrom=-20, xTo=0, yTo=0, xScaleFrom=1.1, yScaleFrom=1.1, xScaleTo=1, yScaleTo=1, duration=7, block=false)]
[name="Kal'tsit"]   Currently, the Lungmen information network captures a lot of information regarding the Reunion Movement. It is good that you recognize the importance of this.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Currently, the Lungmen information network captures a lot of information regarding the Reunion Movement. It is good that you recognize the importance of this.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]   But this alone is not enough. Lungmen still lacks key information.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: But this alone is not enough. Lungmen still lacks key information.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]   I believe the L.G.D. knows very well that this simple quarantine is not enough to hold back Reunion.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: I believe the L.G.D. knows very well that this simple quarantine is not enough to hold back Reunion.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]   Reunion will not obediently go through the inspections, nor will they wait for the authorities to take the initiative. That's why...
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Reunion will not obediently go through the inspections, nor will they wait for the authorities to take the initiative. That's why...

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]   Without Rhodes Island's assistance, Lungmen will suffer heavy losses against Reunion should you decide to pursue the same strategies against the Infected.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Without Rhodes Island's assistance, Lungmen will suffer heavy losses against Reunion should you decide to pursue the same strategies against the Infected.

speaker: Ch'en
content: Pardon the interruption.

raw: [name="Ch'en"]   The L.G.D. understands Lungmen's defenses better than Rhodes Island does. We've already made preparations to deal with possible infiltration from Reunion.
speaker: Ch'en
content: The L.G.D. understands Lungmen's defenses better than Rhodes Island does. We've already made preparations to deal with possible infiltration from Reunion.

raw: [name="Ch'en"]   We, however, are not obliged to provide you with confidential information regarding our operations.
speaker: Ch'en
content: We, however, are not obliged to provide you with confidential information regarding our operations.

speaker: Wei Yenwu
content: Miss Kal'tsit, please continue.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]   While it is true that Lungmen has been successful in dealing with unarmed Infected so far, you have not dealt with this scale of organized rioting before. This may result in unnecessary losses.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: While it is true that Lungmen has been successful in dealing with unarmed Infected so far, you have not dealt with this scale of organized rioting before. This may result in unnecessary losses.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]   From our experience... Only the Infected are capable of countering the Infected.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: From our experience... Only the Infected are capable of countering the Infected.

raw: [name="Wei Yenwu"]   To my understand, Rhodes Island has some special expertise in countering Reunion?
speaker: Wei Yenwu
content: To my understand, Rhodes Island has some special expertise in countering Reunion?

raw: [ImageTween(xFrom=0, yFrom=-0, xTo=0, yTo=0, xScaleFrom=1.2, yScaleFrom=1.2, xScaleTo=1, yScaleTo=1, duration=27, block=false)]
[name="Kal'tsit"]   We do have experience, but I wouldn't call it expertise.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: We do have experience, but I wouldn't call it expertise.

name: char_2005_weiyw_1

raw: [name="Wei Yenwu"]   I've been told that Rhodes Island was involved with the Chernobog incident, and managed to obtain a lot of intel about Reunion.
speaker: Wei Yenwu
content: I've been told that Rhodes Island was involved with the Chernobog incident, and managed to obtain a lot of intel about Reunion.

raw: [CharacterCutin(widgetID="1", name="char_003_kalts_1", style="cutin", fadestyle= "horiz_expand_center", fadetime=0.5, offsetx=-300, width=200, block=true)]
name: char_003_kalts_1

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]   No matter where you heard that from...
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: No matter where you heard that from...

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]   At this stage, that information is not up for exchange. It is but a part of our resume, a qualification that allows us to speak to you, Mister Wei.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: At this stage, that information is not up for exchange. It is but a part of our resume, a qualification that allows us to speak to you, Mister Wei.

raw: [name="Wei Yenwu"]   It is Lungmen that will decide whether or not we will exchange information. If Rhodes Island cannot even provide us with this level of information...
speaker: Wei Yenwu
content: It is Lungmen that will decide whether or not we will exchange information. If Rhodes Island cannot even provide us with this level of information...

speaker: Wei Yenwu
content: Hah.

raw: [name="Wei Yenwu"]   In that case, we simply have no basis for trusting your capabilities.
speaker: Wei Yenwu
content: In that case, we simply have no basis for trusting your capabilities.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]   Mister Wei, I apologise if my words were not clear enough.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Mister Wei, I apologise if my words were not clear enough.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]   What I must emphasize is... the only reason Rhodes Island has this information, is because we were strong enough to obtain it.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: What I must emphasize is... the only reason Rhodes Island has this information, is because we were strong enough to obtain it.

raw: [name="Ch'en"]   Whatever the case may be, Lungmen cannot simply trust another group of Infected.
speaker: Ch'en
content: Whatever the case may be, Lungmen cannot simply trust another group of Infected.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]   Miss Ch'en, if you believe that doling out punishment to the Infected is more important than the actual security of Lungmen...
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Miss Ch'en, if you believe that doling out punishment to the Infected is more important than the actual security of Lungmen...

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]   Then I will immediately surrender myself in accordance with your local laws. Then, I will sigh from my jail while watching Reunion burn down your city.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Then I will immediately surrender myself in accordance with your local laws. Then, I will sigh from my jail while watching Reunion burn down your city.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]   This time, Lungmen doesn't have a choice.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: This time, Lungmen doesn't have a choice.

raw: [CameraShake(duration=0.5, xstrength=10, ystrength=12, vibrato=15, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
[name="Ch'en"]   Your good intentions are not lost upon us despite your rudeness.
speaker: Ch'en
content: Your good intentions are not lost upon us despite your rudeness.

raw: [name="Ch'en"]   However, we also are not a charity for useless lobbyists.
speaker: Ch'en
content: However, we also are not a charity for useless lobbyists.

speaker: Wei Yenwu
content: Madam Ch'en.

raw: [name="Ch'en"]   Chief Wei, I believe it is inappropriate for these outsiders to get involved with Lungmen's confidential matters.
speaker: Ch'en
content: Chief Wei, I believe it is inappropriate for these outsiders to get involved with Lungmen's confidential matters.

raw: [name="Wei Yenwu"]   Calm down, Madam Ch'en. They are still our guests.
speaker: Wei Yenwu
content: Calm down, Madam Ch'en. They are still our guests.

speaker: Wei Yenwu
content: ... My guests.

speaker: Ch'en
content: Very well.

raw: [name="Ch'en"]   Unless they've violated our laws, I will tolerate them, Sir.
speaker: Ch'en
content: Unless they've violated our laws, I will tolerate them, Sir.

raw: [name="Wei Yenwu"]   Ah, excuse me. I just remembered...
speaker: Wei Yenwu
content: Ah, excuse me. I just remembered...

speaker: Wei Yenwu
content: That's right. Hmm...

raw: [name="Wei Yenwu"]   There is one thing that I care about.
speaker: Wei Yenwu
content: There is one thing that I care about.

speaker: Wei Yenwu
content: Your ability.

raw: [name="Wei Yenwu"]   To my understanding, Rhodes Island is also assisting with suppressing the nearby Infected?
speaker: Wei Yenwu
content: To my understanding, Rhodes Island is also assisting with suppressing the nearby Infected?

raw: [name="Wei Yenwu"]   Madam Ch'en, based upon your best information, how would you assess Rhodes Island's combat abilities?
speaker: Wei Yenwu
content: Madam Ch'en, based upon your best information, how would you assess Rhodes Island's combat abilities?

raw: [name="Ch'en"]   ... Allow me to describe what I've witnessed from Rhodes Island's operations.
speaker: Ch'en
content: ... Allow me to describe what I've witnessed from Rhodes Island's operations.

speaker: Ch'en
content: Here are the details...
